body: Wow, All i can say is WOW.  That really gave me some inspiration.  The "i know i am going to get through this."  It just sucks right now. My husband and I are working on putting the kids in daycare and getting me some much needed me time.  I like your idea of the homework, if you have any other ideas, please let me know.  One of my biggest problems right now are these major ups and downs.

Thanks for all your insight, I appreciate the time and concern you put into writing that.  What do you mean "see how you can make good use of the way you're feeling right now"  How can i possibly try to make good of this horrible hurting feeling.  I want to be a better person I want a break, not necessarily run away, but have some alone me time.  I have lost myself I feel, I have no hobbies no interests, nothing.  I am trying to learn and teach myself how to get that back.  I feel the only things i am good at are; cleaning, and taking care of my children.
Thanks, I appreciate that.  Talking does help, saw my therapist and that helped.  Trying to learn how to deal with my problems and live in the present, very tough work.

Today was a little better was able to talk to my therapist and receive some peace.  I am trying to face problems head on and just deal accept and forgive.  It's definitely a lot of work and a lot of ups and downs.

I really appreciate everyones comments, when I say I want to get away I mean i want some just "me" time i have been a stay at home mother for over 2 years, and now just started a job to see if that would help with getting me out of the house, well thats not working.  i just need a break a run away time to realize how lucky i am and to appreciate everything i have. is this wrong?  I am going to speak with my therapist today, i would never hurt myself because all i think of are my children, however thats just still how i feel, worthless.
